My name is Sa’ad. I am a Pakistani. I am six years old. I live with my parents, grandparents, two brothers and a sister. I am in class one.
I go to school in the morning. I eat my lunch during the break after washing my hands with soap and water. I come back home at one o’clock.
First, I do my homework. Then, I pay with my brothers and sister in the evening. I have many toys to play with. Mostly, I love to play with my toy train.
I love to have dinner with my family. Every night, my mother tells me a bedtime story. Then, I go to sleep.
Huma is a good girl. She likes helping others. Today, she is helping her sister Hina. They are making flowers with pencil shavings.
One day, fruits and vegetables met together in a basket. They became friends. One morning, all of them were talking to each other, but Red Carrot was sitting quietly in a corner.
She said, “Juicy Apple always fights with me. He says he is very sweet and healthy. People like to eat him more than I. He makes fun of me.”
All the fruits and vegetables felt sorry for Red Carrot. “You should not feel sad. Allah has blessed us with good health.
We should not fight, "said Yellow Mango. Everyone agreed. Juicy Apple also said sorry to Red Carrot for being rude to her and they became friends again.
All students welcomed her and introduced themselves one at a time. Then they explained the following classroom rules. Let’s go through them.
Ayyan and Maham are very happy. They are making and Eid card in their art class. Let’s see what they are doing. Ayyan takes a piece of paper.
They draw some flowers one it and colour them. They share their colour pencils with each other. Maham writes ‘Eid Mubarak’ on it.
They clean the table after finishing their work. They like to keep their classroom clean. Then they wash their hands with soap and water.
One day, all the animals of the jungle were having fun together. A hare told them proudly that he could run very fast. He was making fun of a tortoise for his slow speed.
The race started. The hare ran very fast and left the tortoise far behind. “I have much time to reach the finish line. I can have some rest,”
The tortoise kept moving slowly. At last, he reached the finish line. The animals loudly cheered for the tortoise. The hare woke up from his sleep.
The tortoise kept walking slowly. At last, he reached the finish line. The animals loudly cheered for the tortoise. The hare woke up from his sleep.
